_provenance: Fictional demo data. Utility name, tariff IDs, and rates are invented for the Sift 'Home Energy Guardian' hackathon scenario and do not describe any real utility, account, or rate filing.
serviceAddressNote: Fictional single-family residence, electric service only. No real address is represented.

rateChangeImpactOnBaselineUsage.note: Isolates how much of the anomaly is explained by the rate change alone, holding usage at the normalized baseline for the current billing period (1075 kWh, see current-bill.json baseline).

totalGapVsPriorTariffAtActualUsage.note: Total gap between the current actual bill and what the bill would have been under the prior tariff at the prior normalized (baseline) usage.
totalGapVsPriorTariffAtActualUsage.arithmeticNote: 248.50 (current actual bill) - 156.38 (prior tariff at baseline usage) = 92.12. Rate change explains 18.62 of that 92.12 (18.62 / 92.12 = 20.21%); the remaining 73.50 (79.79%) is usage-driven and investigated via weather-history.json and household-events.json.
